name: Chaîne des Puys - Limagne fault tectonic arena
description: In the Massif Central of central France, this landscape stretches along a 40-kilometre line of about 70 volcanic cones, domes and craters, with Puy de Dôme (1,465 m) at its heart. The last eruption came around 4040 BC. Beside the volcanoes runs the Limagne fault, where the crust cracked and sank as the continent began to pull apart.
